summary: REQ-1 appears implemented by replacing the landing page hero logo image with centered, responsive gothic-styled text "Falcon Id's". However, the diff also introduces an unrequested/explicitly disallowed mention of a support ticketing system in project metadata.

hallucinated_features.description: Support ticketing system is described as being included (support center page, ticket submission, status viewing, categories), despite being a stated non-goal for this change.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly says not to implement the previously requested support ticketing system; the diff adds metadata claiming it exists.
